title: Kestrel GAP Waiver Addendum Terms: Attachment to the Finance Contract and Term of Coverage
content:
# Kestrel GAP Waiver Addendum — Attachment to the Finance Contract and Term of Coverage

The following terms are identical for every level of the Kestrel GAP Waiver: Kestrel GAP Essential, Kestrel GAP Standard, Kestrel GAP Plus, Kestrel GAP Premier, Kestrel GAP Premier Plus and Kestrel GAP Max.

## Terms

1. **Finance contracts it attaches to.** The waiver is sold only on Kestrel Auto Finance contracts.
2. **Point of sale.** The waiver is sold only at the signing of the finance contract.
3. **Financed price.** The waiver price must be included in the amount financed.
4. **One per contract.** A finance contract may carry only one waiver.
5. **Term.** At sale, the waiver term equals the finance term of the contract.
6. **Start of coverage.** Coverage starts on the finance contract date.
7. **End of coverage by time.** The waiver ends by time on the original maturity date of the finance contract.
8. **Transfer.** The waiver cannot be transferred.

## The same terms by level

| Term | Essential | Standard | Plus | Premier | Premier Plus | Max |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sold only on Kestrel Auto Finance contracts | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Sold only at finance contract signing | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Price must be included in the amount financed | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Only one waiver per finance contract | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Waiver term equals the finance term at sale | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Coverage starts on the finance contract date | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Event that ends the waiver by time | Original maturity date | Original maturity date | Original maturity date | Original maturity date | Original maturity date | Original maturity date |
| Transfer allowed | No | No | No | No | No | No |

## Points of reading

- The term is fixed against the finance term **as it stood at sale**; the end date by time is the **original** maturity date, the date set when the contract was signed.
- Because the waiver is sold only at signing and only on a Kestrel Auto Finance contract, a contract written by another lender cannot carry a Kestrel GAP Waiver, and a waiver cannot be added to a Kestrel Auto Finance contract after its signing.

### Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A Kestrel Auto Finance contract dated 3 March of one year with a 72-month term and an original maturity date in March six years later carries a waiver whose term is 72 months; coverage begins on the 3 March contract date and the waiver ends by time on that original maturity date.
